    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    i,j=start; g[i][j]=1

            d=(d+1)%4
            ni,nj=i+dirs[d][0],j+dirs[d][1]
            if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w) or g[ni][nj]:
                break
        i,j=ni,nj; g[i][j]=1; drawn+=1
        if drawn>h*w: break
